name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: An unofficial native Debian 13 AMD64 Proxmox LXC adaptation of the officially Docker-based Nginx Proxy Manager application. It builds the pinned official source and OpenResty environment without installing a nested container runtime.

notes.text: Development status: the supported v2.15.1 Proxmox runtime matrix has been exercised successfully. One final start/reboot smoke check remains after enabling the Proxmox nesting feature by default. Backup/restore and adaptation-level update tooling are future project options and are not part of the current supported feature set.

The container remains unprivileged. The launcher enables nesting=1 to avoid the recurring Proxmox Systemd 257 nesting warning; keyctl remains disabled. Nginx Proxy Manager itself does not use Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, or another nested container runtime.
The administration interface is on port 81. HTTP and HTTPS proxy traffic use ports 80 and 443. The internal backend port 3000 and SQLite database remain local to the container.
Nginx Proxy Manager v2.15.1 uses a first-run setup wizard when no administrator exists. This adaptation does not create or display default credentials.
